syncConflicts.title: Sync conflicts
syncConflicts.description: Operations recorded without a connection that break a rule. They were not blocked: check each case, correct it at the POS register if needed and mark it as resolved.
syncConflicts.noPermission: You don’t have permission to view sync conflicts.
syncConflicts.noLocation: Choose a location at the top to see its conflicts.
syncConflicts.empty: No open conflicts. Everything is in sync.
syncConflicts.openCount: {count, plural, one {# open conflict} other {# open conflicts}}
syncConflicts.resolveText: Record what you did. The note is saved in the audit log.
syncConflicts.notePlaceholder: e.g. refunded difference of CHF 12.50 in cash
syncConflicts.noteRequired: Please enter a note (500 characters max).

unknownCode.what: A rule violation was detected during sync.
unknownCode.todo: Check the operation and the order at the POS register.

overpayment.label: Overpayment
overpayment.what: The order was paid twice or overpaid, for example at two POS registers while there was no connection. The payment was accepted anyway.
overpayment.todo: Check the amount and refund the difference at the POS register.

payment_on_closed_order.label: Payment after closing
payment_on_closed_order.what: A payment came in for an order that was already paid or closed. The payment was accepted anyway.
payment_on_closed_order.todo: Find out whether the guest paid twice and, if necessary, refund the amount at the POS register.

refund_exceeds_payment.label: Refund too high
refund_exceeds_payment.what: More was refunded than had been paid with this payment. The refund was accepted anyway.
refund_exceeds_payment.todo: Compare the payment and the refund, recount the cash register and clear up the difference with the person responsible.

source_has_payments.label: Order with payments
source_has_payments.what: Items were to be transferred or orders merged or split, but the order already had payments. The operation was not carried out.
source_has_payments.todo: Check the orders at the POS register and repeat the operation if it is still needed.

order_not_found.label: Unknown order
order_not_found.what: The operation concerns an order the system doesn’t know. It had no effect.
order_not_found.todo: Usually the order still arrives from another device; the operation is then applied automatically. If it is still missing, check that all POS registers are connected.

order_state.label: Order no longer open
order_state.what: The operation concerned an order that was already paid, closed or voided. A void was accepted anyway; other changes had no effect.
order_state.todo: Check the order. If something was voided after payment, refund the amount at the POS register; otherwise repeat the operation if it is still needed.

item_not_found.label: Unknown item
item_not_found.what: The operation concerns an item the system doesn’t know. It had no effect.
item_not_found.todo: If the item arrives later, the operation is applied automatically. If it is still missing, check the order at the POS register.

item_state.label: Item can no longer be changed
item_state.what: An item was to be changed although its status no longer allowed it, for example the quantity after it was sent to the kitchen. The operation had no effect.
item_state.todo: Check the order at the POS register and correct it if needed, for example with a void.

implicit_reopen.label: Order reopened
implicit_reopen.what: Items were added to an order that was already closed. The order was therefore reopened automatically.
implicit_reopen.todo: Check whether the new items still need to be paid, then take payment for them or void them.

approval_invalid.label: Invalid approval
approval_invalid.what: The operation was approved by someone who didn’t have permission to do so. It was accepted anyway because it has already happened.
approval_invalid.todo: Check whether the operation was in order and, if needed, adjust the permissions under “Staff”.

user_inactive.label: Person deactivated
user_inactive.what: The operation was recorded with the PIN of a person who was deactivated at the time. It was accepted anyway.
user_inactive.todo: Find out who was using the device and check the operation. Connect the POS registers so they load the current staff list.

duplicate_number.label: Duplicate number
duplicate_number.what: An order, receipt or copy number was assigned twice. It was saved with a suffix; nothing was lost.
duplicate_number.todo: Usually there is nothing to do. Note that the saved number may differ from the one on the printed receipt.

clock_skew.label: Device clock wrong
clock_skew.what: The device clock was more than 5 minutes fast. The time of the operation was corrected to the server time.
clock_skew.todo: Check the device’s date and time and turn on automatic time setting.

invalid.label: Invalid operation
invalid.what: The operation was incomplete or belonged to another location. It was not accepted.
invalid.todo: Check with the person at the device what was meant to be recorded and re-enter it if needed. If this happens often, contact support.

cash_without_shift.label: Cash without a shift
cash_without_shift.what: A cash payment or refund was recorded with no shift open. It was kept, but it belongs to no cash count.
cash_without_shift.todo: Find out which drawer the money went into and balance it with a cash movement.

shift_not_found.label: Unknown shift
shift_not_found.what: The operation names a shift the system does not know. The money was kept anyway.
shift_not_found.todo: The shift usually still arrives from another device. If it stays missing, check that all devices are connected.

shift_closed.label: Shift already closed
shift_closed.what: Money went into a shift that was already closed, or it was closed a second time. The first closing counts.
shift_closed.todo: Check whether the money is in the drawer and balance it with a cash movement in the current shift.

shift_mismatch.label: Someone else's shift
shift_mismatch.what: Money was booked into the shift of another till or another person. It was kept anyway.
shift_mismatch.todo: Find out who has the money and balance both shifts with cash movements.

shift_already_open.label: Second open shift
shift_already_open.what: A second shift was opened for the same till or person while the first was still open (RN-19).
shift_already_open.todo: Close both shifts with a cash count and check where the money was counted.

shift_count_mismatch.label: Expected cash differs
shift_count_mismatch.what: When it closed, the device did not know all payments of the shift: the signed expected cash differs from the computed one.
shift_count_mismatch.todo: Compare the shift report with the payments and explain the difference.

day_closed.label: After the day closing
day_closed.what: The operation belongs to a day that is already closed (Z). It was kept and shows as a correction of that closing.
day_closed.todo: Check the correction in the day closing; the closing itself never changes.
